summary: Rumble Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of transactions contemplated by a November 10, 2025 Business Combination Agreement with Northern Data AG, alongside Transaction Support Agreements with Tether Investments, ART Holding GmbH, and Apeiron Investment Group. The deal closed June 17, 2026, with Rumble acquiring Northern Data. Rumble issued shares and pre-funded warrants to Tether, now holding registration rights for resale. No per-share price, premium, or break fee is stated. The transaction appears structured as a stock-based acquisition. Watch for registration statements and potential shareholder litigation or regulatory reviews regarding the combination.
